title: Pending UPI or successful-but-unreceived payments - explained
content: A pending UPI status means the final outcome is not yet confirmed in the displayed record. A successful status with a receiver reporting no credit can also require reference-based reconciliation; repeated payment attempts can create duplicate payments.
